summary: Build practical CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Terraform, and DevSecOps controls. Enroll to improve release reliability.
lede: CI/CD pipeline design and automation structures repeatable build, test, and release workflows for software delivery teams. For DevOps, release, platform, QA, and engineering leads, it covers planning branching and integration, defining automated quality and security gates, and designing deployment controls with rollback procedures across container and infrastructure-as-code environments.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to turn delivery intent into reliable CI/CD pipeline design and automation.
prerequisites: You should have a working understanding of software development workflows, Git fundamentals, and basic testing concepts. Familiarity with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes, or Terraform is helpful but not required. No coding language specialization is required, although you should be comfortable reading YAML-style pipeline configuration and discussing release processes with developers, QA, and operations teams.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
